name: Power Saving
author: Kike Ferrater
description: Five idle stages, each with its own switch and timeout: screensaver and monitor standby for the display, lock and suspend for the system, and hibernate where the system supports it. Adds the monitor standby, idle suspend and hibernate that Omarchy does not have.

barWidget.description: Status icon with a panel that shows the idle stages in firing order, switches each on or off and sets its minutes. Right-click toggles stay-awake.
